scope: A fresh Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind control plane writes its native JSONL audit log to a runner-temporary directory. The case selects one actual ResponseComplete event for a case-owned synthetic ConfigMap create by exact objectRef name, hashes and preserves its raw JSONL bytes, then uploads those bytes to an isolated Versity S3 gateway backed by emptyDir. Normal S3 APIs compare permanent deletion of an unlocked version with a COMPLIANCE-retained version, verify a new version and retention shortening, exercise a delete marker, and retrieve the exact locked version. This does not establish legal retention duration, managed-provider behavior, production delivery, or production capacity/durability.

checks.claim: The same credential can permanently delete an unlocked version of the same audit bytes
The exact locked version retains its active COMPLIANCE period after a rejected shortening
A distinct successor and delete marker cannot remove the retained original version
The original Kubernetes audit bytes are retrieved before and after the exact delete attempt
